claim_reviews.reason: Covariance linearity gives Cov(y,x) from beta and covariate blocks and gives Cov(y1,y2)=rho*A+C+beta^T B beta when residualu is independent of x. With S=W+B and symmetric valid matrices, all transpose orientations match Eq6.5. Equivalently L diag(Sigma_u,Sigma_x) L^T yields the full displayed block matrix. This covariance identity itself needs finite second moments and independence/uncorrelatedness as stated; Gaussianity additionally supplies the distributional/conditional interpretation.
claim_reviews.actual_check: Independently used already installed SymPy exact rational block matrices for q1..5 and rho1/.5, with nonconstant beta. All10 exact products matched the separate displayed blocks. No model fitting, integration or random draws.
claim_reviews.limits: Ten finite checks alone do not prove an arbitrary-dimensional theorem; the written linear-transformation derivation supplies the general identity. They do not establish empirical fit, missingness ignorability or parameter recovery.

claim_reviews.reason: For fixed known jointly Gaussian moments, completing the square gives the stated conditional mean and Schur-complement covariance. The removed term isPSD. Additional observations subtract their residual cross-covariance quadratic form after conditioning on existing observations. A nonzero residual cross-covariance gives a nonzeroPSD reduction; for vectors it need not be positive definite in every direction. The scalar example has strict reductions.
claim_reviews.independent_route: Sequential scalar residualization, independent of the submitted general inverse routine: after x2, Cov(x1,y1)=3/4 and Var(y1)=11/8; after addingy1, Cov(x1,y2)=-3/10 and Var(y2)=39/50. Final reduction is(3/10)^2/(39/50)=3/26, giving12/11-3/26=279/286.
claim_reviews.limits: Conditional uncertainty for a missing value with known moments is not a fitted biometric-parameter standard error. No universal finite-fitSE reduction, power increase or MNAR validity is proved. Marginal correlation alone does not imply incremental information after conditioning.

claim_reviews.reason: The source gives V=step(L-0) and Bernoulli probability0.999whenV=1,0.001otherwise. Hence E[X|V]=epsilon+(1-2epsilon)V with epsilon1/1000. A conditional Gaussian liability gives P(X=1)=epsilon+(1-2epsilon)Phi(mu/sigma). For distinct conditionally independent observation errors, total covariance yields Cov(X1,X2)=(1-2epsilon)^2 Cov(V1,V2); individual variance also includes conditional Bernoulli variance.
claim_reviews.independent_check: Direct exact finite-law calculation for a nonsymmetric rational joint distribution of(V1,V2) verified covariance attenuation, supplementing the written total-covariance derivation. The same-variable variance is not incorrectly multiplied without adding observation noise.
claim_reviews.hierarchy_qualification: Given fixed gamma_cov and positive-definite precision matrices, sharedfamilypsi givesB_z=tau_b_z^-1 and independent twin innovations giveW_z=tau_w_z^-1. The source uses separateMZ/DZ matrices; latent diagonal blocksB_z+W_z and cross-twin blockB_z are conditional statements. Integrating Wishart/mean priors need not yield aGaussian marginal or finite prior-predictive covariances.
claim_reviews.limits: Threshold0 is not an identification proof for all latent scales. The step convention at0 is immaterial for nondegenerate Gaussianliability probability but the kernel is explicitly stochastic. No convergence, calibration or adequacy ofepsilonapproximation is shown.
